findings.title: The four headline figures do not stand apart from the panels below

location.description: The strip of four figures (Seats booked, Class revenue, Seats filled, New students) under the page title.

findings.viewer_experience: The strip sits on the same white as every panel below it, so nothing tells the viewer these are the numbers to read first.

current.value: A white strip with the same fill and outline as the charts and table beneath it.

findings.target: The strip of figures reads as the top tier of the page, apart from the panels below.
findings.fix_direction: Set the headline strip apart from the panels below it.

closed_when.check: Look at the page: the four figures clearly read as the first thing to look at, apart from the panels.
